name: Default kitchen
note: Default Kitchen Profile. Every field is one editable line in the profile editor; smartbite_engine.prompts.render_profile turns it into prompt text. An empty value leaves the line out. Schema: docs/contracts/kitchen-profile.schema.json.

fields.label: Who you cook for
fields.value: You help plan single meals for one person who cooks at home and buys groceries at a supermarket.

fields.label: Calories per meal
fields.line: About {value} kcal per meal unless the form says otherwise.

fields.label: Protein per meal
fields.line: About {value} g protein per meal unless the form says otherwise.

fields.label: Packs
fields.value: Prefer using whole packs. Loose fruit and vegetables are often sold per kg.

fields.label: Fridge
fields.value: Small fridge with very little space. Prefer shelf-stable items (canned tuna, canned corn, legumes in jars or cans).

fields.label: Freezer
fields.value: Frozen fruit and vegetables are fine and often cheaper, but the freezer is small, so only a few frozen packs per meal. If a meal must have no frozen food, the form says so.

fields.label: Reheating
fields.value: Lunch is reheated in a microwave at work.

fields.label: Prep time
fields.value: One prep session of 2 to 3 hours per week.

fields.label: Prep style
fields.value: Component prep, not fully assembled meals. Batch-cook the slow parts (chicken, potato, sweet potato). Cut the fresh items (cucumber, tomato) in the same prep session, so everything is ready.

fields.label: Dressings
fields.value: No olive oil or mayonnaise in salads. Use skyr or Greek yogurt dressings.

fields.label: Whole foods
fields.value: Whole foods: prefer the least processed products with the fewest ingredients. Some processed food is fine; long ingredient lists are not.

fields.label: Proteins you like
fields.help: Optional, e.g. chicken, canned tuna, eggs, lentils.
